text:
maria: heads up — deploybot preflight is timing out during artifact upload in the release-cut window, blocking promotion. trying to grab logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/5189994321 :exclamation:
deploy-bot: preflight failed: artifact-upload -> upload timed out after 180s (s3-proxy 504). automatic retry scheduled (3/3).
jon: which step exactly? checksum verification or the final blob mount?
sam: i saw it hang at 99% on multipart commit, then 504 from s3-proxy. happening across a few runners.
maria: repro steps in CI: `bazel build //release:bundle && curl -T bundle.tar https://registry.redwood.internal/upload` — curl stalls on PUT commit.
lee: change window ends in 45m. if retries keep failing we should pin last-good and abort cut. we can't risk partial rollouts.
olivia: oncall here — is there an easy manual fallback? can we promote the previously tagged image v1.4.2 right now?
sam: yes -> last-promoted is v1.4.2. quick promote would be `deploybot promote --tag v1.4.2 --env prod --reason "rollback due to artifact upload timeouts"`
maria: agree. i don't want to chase infra during the cut. propose pin to v1.4.2, abort the new cut, and open infra ticket for s3-proxy.
jon: :thumbsup: pin + abort. also add a manual hold in the console so auto-promote doesn't retry.
lee: i'll mark the release as blocked and create the rollback PR to pin the release manifest to v1.4.2.
olivia: i'll notify CS and the release slack channel, and kick an incident with infra for s3-proxy 504s.
deploy-bot: promotion aborted by human: reason="pin to last-good due to upload timeouts" user=lee timestamp=5189994300
maria: thanks — rolling back now. after pin, we can re-run a canary next week once infra fix is verified.
jon: note for follow-up: capture CI runner regions, and any correlation with large payloads. add to postmortem.
sam: created infra ticket INF-3421 and linked the CI traces.
lee: done — manifest pinned, release aborted, notifying PMs. :white_check_mark:
maria: closing thread here. we'll re-open if anything else pops up.
